abhī.g: upasaggo, haritunti attho, gaṇhitunti vuttaṁ hoti.
upasaggamattaṁ, lakkhaṇīyesu icceva attho, uposathasamādānadhammassavanapūjāsakkārādikaraṇatthaṁ lakkhitabbesu sallakkhetabbesu upalakkhetabbesūti vuttaṁ hoti.
upasaggo, haritunti attho, gaṇhitunti vuttaṁ hoti.
upasaggamattaṁ, sampajānapadaṁ nirodhapadena antarikaṁ katvā vuttaṁ.

abhi.g: upasaggo, haritunti attho, gaṇhitunti vuttaṁ hoti.
upasaggamattaṁ, lakkhaṇīyesu icceva attho, uposathasamādānadhammassavanapūjāsakkārādikaraṇatthaṁ lakkhitabbesu sallakkhetabbesu upalakkhetabbesūti vuttaṁ hoti.
upasaggo, haritunti attho, gaṇhitunti vuttaṁ hoti.
upasaggamattaṁ, sampajānapadaṁ nirodhapadena antarikaṁ katvā vuttaṁ.

Abhī.g: idaṁ pana padasobhaṇatthe upasaggamattameva, tasmā yo bhikkhu vuttalakkhaṇāya vehāsakuṭiyā sabbantimena paricchedena yāva pamāṇamajjhimassa purisassa sabbaso heṭṭhimāhi tulāhi sīsaṁ na ghaṭṭeti, ettakaṁ uccāya tulānaṁ upari ṭhapite āhaccapādake mañce vā pīṭhe vā nisīdati vā nipajjati vā, tassa Anupakhajjasikkhāpade vuttanayena payogagaṇanāya pācittiyaṁ.

Abhi.g: idaṁ pana padasobhaṇatthe upasaggamattameva, tasmā yo bhikkhu vuttalakkhaṇāya vehāsakuṭiyā sabbantimena paricchedena yāva pamāṇamajjhimassa purisassa sabbaso heṭṭhimāhi tulāhi sīsaṁ na ghaṭṭeti, ettakaṁ uccāya tulānaṁ upari ṭhapite āhaccapādake mañce vā pīṭhe vā nisīdati vā nipajjati vā, tassa Anupakhajjasikkhāpade vuttanayena payogagaṇanāya pācittiyaṁ.
idaṁ yamakapāṭihāriyassa supākaṭabhāvadassanatthaṁ, aññehi bodhimūlañātisamāgamādīsu katapāṭihāriyehi visesanatthañca vuttaṁ.
idaṁ pana tassa yamakapāṭihāriyassa supākaṭabhāvadassanatthaṁ, aññehi bodhimūle ñātisamāgamādīsu ca katapāṭihāriyehi visesadassanatthañca vuttaṁ.
